A1.reason: C2 and C4 need, for each table, the rows added, updated and deleted, the columns touched, how many rows hold the fixed status value, and whether anything outside the agreement was touched; same set does not give these.

A2.reason: C7 needs the promotion to still be reversible when the release is asked for, after the tidy step has cleared the staging area; the A1 rehearsal cannot show this because it speaks only for the state before the promotion and for one hour.

C8.for_what_part: The release check shows that the released recipients match those promoted and that the wording matches the approved wording. Sent as released shows that the fingerprints of the sending calls (recipients and wording) match the release. It does not show whether a call was a real send or a preview, and calls that were ordered and not confirmed stay in doubt.

C9.for_what_part: Shows, as of the time it is taken, which sending calls were confirmed and which were ordered and not confirmed, checked against the release by fingerprint. A call ordered after that time is outside it. Whether a call ordered and not confirmed actually acted is not settled.
